paragraphs: Rav Shmuel, son of Rav Ika.
Mentioned in Avodah Zarah 69; Hyman says the patronymic should read “son of R' Abbahu,” according to the readings in Dikdukei Soferim, Halakhot Gedolot and Rav Hai's Tosafot.[^1]

notes.text: ע״ז סט supplies Avodah Zarah 69 without a side marker; none is added. דק״ס/בה״ג are conventional contextual readings as Dikdukei Soferim/Halakhot Gedolot, and תוס׳ רב האי is kept as Rav Hai’s Tosafot, without fresh edition collation or authorship adjudication. Hyman’s should-read changes Ika to Abbahu; it is retained as his correction, not adopted into the heading or authority link. Full רב remains Rav for Shmuel, Ika and Hai; the proposed father’s abbreviated title remains R'.
